name: Siyuan (Max) Meng
description: Ph.D. in Civil Engineering at UMass Amherst. Research on Infrastructure-Centric World Models, roadside LiDAR perception, and transportation optimization.

research.title: From sensing to understanding.
research.intro: Connecting reliable perception, traffic safety, and decisions at the infrastructure level.

directions.title:
Roadside intelligent
perception
directions.description: Multi-LiDAR and multi-sensor methods for background modeling, 3D object detection, and robust tracking in complex traffic environments.

directions.title:
Quality-aware
transportation safety
directions.description: Understanding how sensing and tracking quality affect traffic conflict analysis, with an emphasis on uncertainty and spatial precision.

directions.title:
Transportation
system optimization
directions.description: Developing multi-objective optimization methods for roadway asset management, EV charging infrastructure, and sustainable transportation systems.

vision.title: Infrastructure-Centric World Models
vision.description: Fixed roadside sensors observe the same environment over time. I study how this temporal depth can support reliable, evolving representations of traffic scenes—connecting multi-LiDAR perception with V2X cooperation, spatial intelligence, and uncertainty-aware reasoning.

framework.title: Four studies. A connected framework.
framework.intro: My doctoral work connects roadside point clouds to traffic safety analysis, with quality and reliability as recurring questions at every stage.
framework.quality: Quality & reliability: background confidence · detection quality · trajectory continuity · interpretable safety measures

感知
directions.description: 面向复杂交通环境，研究多激光雷达与多传感器背景建模、三维目标检测和稳健跟踪方法。

directions.title:
质量感知的
交通安全分析
directions.description: 研究感知与跟踪质量对交通冲突分析的影响，重点关注不确定性与空间精度。

directions.title:
交通
系统优化
directions.description: 面向道路资产管理、电动汽车充电基础设施与可持续交通系统，构建多目标优化方法。

vision.title: 基础设施中心世界模型
vision.description: 固定路侧传感器能够持续观察同一环境。我关注如何利用这种“时间深度”构建可靠、持续演化的交通场景表征，将多激光雷达感知与 V2X 协同感知、空间智能和不确定性感知相连接。
